newsitem.title: ITALY: Btp/Bund spread falls to 139 bps on new benchmarks.
newsitem.headline: Btp/Bund spread falls to 139 bps on new benchmarks.

text.p: The spread between the Italian 10-year benchmark Btp bond and the equivalent 10-year German Bund narrowed to 139 basis points by midsession.
The fall took out the previous low of 148 basis points and was due to a change in the benchmark bonds, traders said.
For Germany, the January 2007 bund has replaced the April 2006 bund as benchmark and for Italy, the November 2006 Btp has taken the place of the July 2006 Btp.
At midsession, the January 2007 bund yielded 5.84 percent and the November 2006 Btp yielded 7.23 percent.
Until Monday night, the spread between the previous benchmark bonds was at 149 basis points, with the April 2006 bund yielding 7.30 percent and the July 2006 Btp 5.81 percent.
